source_text: Sed et quod ait: pro omni primitivo qui adaperit vulvam, non facile explanatur. Non quicumque adaperit vulvam continuo dignus sanctificatione primitivatus est; psalmus dicit: alienati sunt peccatores a vulva, erraverunt a ventre, locuti sunt falsa — quod secundum litteram stare non potest. Quaerenda est vulva quam adaperit omnis primitivus Deo sanctificatus. Deus adaperuit vulvam Liae et Rachel. Levitae erunt mihi; meum est omne primitivum ex die qua percussi primogenita Aegypti. Quis primogenitos Aegyptiorum — principatus et potestates — percussit? Dominus Iesus Christus, primogenitus omnis creaturae, qui adversas potestates triumphavit in cruce. Nisi ille percussisset, sanctificatio primitivatus ad nos venire non potuisset. Ipse primogenitus ex mortuis nos credentes adsumit in ordinem primitivorum, si gratiam usque ad finem firmam retinuerimus.
pass_a_gloss: But also what he-says: for every firstborn who opens womb, not easily is-explained. Not whoever opens womb immediately worthy of-sanctification of-firstborn-status is; psalm says: estranged are sinners from womb, they-erred from belly, they-spoke false-things — which according-to letter to-stand not is-able. To-be-sought is womb which opens every firstborn to-God sanctified. God opened womb of-Leah and Rachel. Levites will-be to-me; mine is every firstborn from day on-which I-struck firstborns of-Egypt. Who firstborns of-Egyptians — principalities and powers — struck? Lord Jesus Christ, firstborn of-every creature, who hostile powers triumphed on cross. Unless he had-struck, sanctification of-firstborn-status to us to-come not would-have-been-able. He firstborn from dead us believing takes into order of-firstborns, if grace unto end firm we-shall-have-held.
pass_b_english: And what it says — [[for every firstborn who opens the womb >> Bible:Numbers 3:12]] — is not easy to unfold. Not everyone who opens a womb is at once worthy of the firstborn sanctification; the psalm says [[sinners are estranged from the womb; they went astray from the belly; they spoke lies >> Bible:Psalm 58:3]] — which cannot stand by the bare letter. We must seek that womb which every firstborn sanctified to God opens. God once [[opened Leah’s womb >> Bible:Genesis 29:31]] and Rachel’s. [[They shall be mine as Levites; every firstborn is mine from the day I struck the firstborn of Egypt >> Bible:Numbers 3:12-13]]. Who struck Egypt’s firstborns — the principalities and powers? My Lord Jesus Christ, [[the firstborn of all creation >> Bible:Colossians 1:15]], who [[disarmed the rulers and authorities, triumphing over them on the cross >> Bible:Colossians 2:15]]. Unless he had struck them down, firstborn sanctification could never have reached us. He, [[firstborn from the dead >> Bible:Colossians 1:18]], takes us who believe into the order of the firstborns — if we hold the grace firm to the end.
